chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام about the minimum of what menstruation may be, and he said: Its minimum is three days, and its furthest limit is ten.

key_terms.أَبْعَدُهُ: its furthest limit; the maximum extent
key_terms.أَدْنَىٰ: minimum; the least amount or shortest duration
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation; the legally recognized menstrual bleeding discussed in fiqh
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: three days; the minimum duration specified for hayd
key_terms.عَشَرَةٌ: ten; the maximum number of days for hayd in this ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of hayd according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام regarding the minimum and maximum duration of hayd. It establishes that the minimum duration is three days and the maximum limit is ten days, making it relevant to jurisprudential rulings concerning ritual purity and acts of worship.
